title: Kiddie Pool Shark
premise: A great white is doing laps in a two-foot plastic pool. It is wearing floaties. The rubber duck is the one having the crisis.
visual: Backyard, chain-link, a cheap blue kiddie pool overflowing. A huge cartoon shark jammed in it, dorsal fin taller than the fence, two bright orange water-wings on its pectoral fins. It grins at a trembling yellow rubber duck on the rim. A garden gnome watches with opera glasses. Hose still running.
characterLean: Pure cutaway. Use after anyone says they are keeping it casual. The gnome is the only adult in the yard and is not helping.
